paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Hazor kumppaangaazak in, Madon kumpipa Jobab, Shimron kumpipa leh Akshaph kumpipa,
heading: Joshua In Jabin Leh Alawite Azou

paite: Mallam tanggam kumpipate, Kineroth simlam a Arabah kumpipate, Phaigam kumpipate leh tumlam pang a Dor kumpipate,
suahlam leh tumlam a om Kanaan mite, tanggam a om, Amorte, Hitte, Perizte, Jebuste, Mizpah gam Hermon tang nuai a om Hivte kiang ah mi asawl hi.
Huan asepaih tengteng uh toh mi tampi, atamdan uh tuipi a piaunel zah mahmah sakol leh kangtalai tampi toh akisa uhi.
Huai kumpipa tengteng akimukhawm ua Israelte dou ding in Merom tuite ah agiakkhawm uhi.

TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah, "Amaute lau ke'n. Zingchiang in hichih hun in amaute hihlupsa vek in Israelte ka hon pe mai ding hi. Asakolte khukguh na kilawisak dia, akangtalaite uh na halsak ding uh," achi hi.
Joshua leh gal dou thei mi tengteng Merom tuite ah ava kuan guih ua adou uhi.
TOUPA'N Israelte khut ah apia a adou ua, Zidon lianzaw pha in, Misrephoth-maim munte pha in, suahlam pang a Mizpeh Phaizangte pha in adelh ua, khat leng hawi nei lou in athat vek uhi.
TOUPA'N asawl bang in Joshua in atung uah ahih a; asakolte khukguh akilawisak ua, akangtalaite uh ahalsak uhi.
Huai hun in Joshua akilehhei a, Hazor khua ala a, akumpipa uh namsau in athat hi. Tuma in Hazor khua huai lai a hiai gamte tengteng lak a khopi pen ahi.
Huai khua a om tengteng namsau in athat vek a, ahihchimit vek a, ahing peuhmah khat mah leng ahinghawi kei uhi.
Huchi in Kumpipate khopi tengteng leh akumpipa tengteng uh Joshua in aman vek a, namsau a dou in athat a, ahihchimit vek a; TOUPA sikha Mosi in thu apiak bang in.
Mual pawng a khopi a na om khinsate, Hazor khua chih louh, Israelte'n khat mah leng ahal kei uh. Huai khua bel Joshua in ahal hi.
Hiai khopite a gallak tengteng leh gante Israel suante'n amau a tuam ding in anei ua; mihing bel ahihman vek masiah uh namsau in athat zel ua, ahing peuhmah hawi anei kei uhi.
TOUPA'N a sikha Mosi thu apiak bang in, Mosi in huai thu Joshua apesawn a; Joshua in huai bang in ahih zel hi. TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak tengteng hih louh himhim anei kei hi.
Huai bang in Joshua in huai gam tengteng, tanggamte, sim gam tengteng, Goshen gam tengteng, phaizang leh phaizang teng leh Israelte tangte leh phaizang teng toh ala vek hi.
heading: Joshua Gam Lakte

paite: Seir va suntou Halak tang a pan Hermon tang nuai a Lebanon Phaizang a Baal-gad pha in akumpipate tengteng uh aman a that in ahihlum hi.
Joshua in huai kumpipa tengteng sawtpitak adou hi.
Gibeon a om Hivte kia chih louh Israelte toh lemna bawl khua a-om kei uh. Dou a lak vek ahi uhi.
TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang a, ahihchimit vek a, deihsakna nei het lou a, ahihman theihna dia alungtang uh hihkhauhsak a Israelte dou sakpa TOUPA ahi.
Huai lai in Joshua akuan a, tanggamte a pan, Hebron a pan, Debir a pan, Anab khua leh Judia tanggam tengteng leh Israel tanggam tengteng a pan Anakte ahihmang vek hi.
Israel suante gam ah Anakte khat lel leng atengta kei ua; Gaza, Gath leh Ashdod khuate kia ah bel a-om lai uhi.

Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang a, agen tengteng bang in Joshua in gam pumpi alata hi. Joshua in Israelte anam uh kikhendan bang zel in agouluah ding un gam ape chiat hi. Huchi in gam galmuang in a-omta hi.
